💻 Running: `Get-ChildItem "backend\target" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Length; Write-Hos`## Project Summary — AI Disaster Management System

**What it is:** A full-stack enterprise Disaster Response Platform (Emergency Operations Center) with AI features, built with **Spring Boot (Java 17) backend** + **React/MUI frontend**.

### Working Condition — verified:
- ✅ **Backend compiles & runs** — built jar (`ai-disaster-management-2.0.0.jar`, ~64MB), started successfully on port 8080 (Tomcat, Spring Boot 3.2.0), no errors in error logs
- ✅ **Frontend compiles** — production build exists in `dist/` (Vite build succeeded), dev server logs show clean HMR
- ✅ **7 integration tests** in `backend/src/test` (Auth, AI Engine, Disaster, EOC, WebSocket/Monitoring, Rescue Teams)
- ⚠️ Kanban: **100 tasks done**, 14 in-progress, 69 backlog (mostly README updates, final e2e validation, hardening)

### Features Implemented (working)

**Core (v1-v2, preserved & working):** JWT auth + roles (USER/ADMIN), disaster reporting (8 types, 4 severities, 6-status lifecycle), AI damage prediction & resource optimization, interactive Leaflet maps (3 layers), live drone GPS simulation, full CRUD for Hospitals/Shelters/Volunteers/Resources/Drones, notification center with unread badge, mock SMS/email alerts, analytics (12+ metrics, Recharts), CSV/PDF exports, audit logging, H2 database with seed data.

**v3.0 additions (done):** User management (CRUD, roles, activate/reset), real-time WebSocket live updates, enhanced AI (priority/risk score, confidence %, response/recovery estimates), rescue team coordination (teams/members/vehicles/equipment/missions/shifts), route optimization (Haversine, multi-destination), case study analysis with comparison charts, admin control center + system health, MUI command-center redesign (deep blue #0F4C81 theme), dark mode, breadcrumbs, animated counters, skeletons, empty states, 404/403 pages, user profiles.

**Plus extras beyond README:** Public disaster reporting & tracking, file uploads, refresh tokens, Flyway + PostgreSQL profile, Swagger/OpenAPI.

### Tech Stack
- **Backend:** Java 17, Spring Boot 3.2, Spring Security + JWT (jjwt, BCrypt), Spring Data JPA, Spring WebSocket, H2 (dev) + PostgreSQL (prod), Flyway, OpenCSV, OpenAPI, Maven
- **Frontend:** React 18, Vite 5, Material UI v9 + Emotion, React Router 6, Axios, Recharts, React-Leaflet/OSM, STOMP.js + SockJS, React Hot Toast, jspdf/papaparse

### Main gaps (not yet fully validated)
Final end-to-end verification report, README updates for newer modules, and some hardening tasks remain in backlog. No unit tests, only integration tests.
